name: المدرسه التحديث القديم | OG-School
desc:
game built for players who want a classic chess experience in Roblox. Play against your friends or challenge other players using the full official rules of chess.

Features:

♟️ Complete chess rules
👥 Play with friends or other players
🎮 Smooth and simple gameplay
🏆 Perfect for casual and competitive matches

Disclaimer: This game is an original chess experience and is not affiliated with, based on, or related to Stuchell Hangout (or any similar game).
